'''Decipher deck designs''' were constructed 60 card decks Decipher published on decipher.com under Star Wars CCG Deck Designs<ref name="idx">[https://web.archive.org/web/20010608205634/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/deckdesigns/index.html Decipher Deck Designs index] (Wayback 8 June 2001)</ref>.   Some of these were constructed off of player's decklist sheets or player submitted articles.
